name: Inp-Video Ads PRO – Video Bubble & WhatsApp Marketing
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Transform anonymous visitors into customers with the power of video.

Inp-Video Ads PRO is the ultimate lead generation tool that humanizes your WordPress site. Instead of a boring, static chat icon, you can now engage your audience with a personalized video greeting that follows them as they browse.

This interactive “Video Popup” creates an immediate bond of trust. When your visitors see a real person talking to them, your conversion rates skyrocket. Perfect for WooCommerce stores, professional portfolios, and landing pages where trust is the key to closing a sale.

Why Inp-Video Ads PRO?
* Universal License: Install and activate your video bubble on UNLIMITED domains with a single master key. Ideal for agencies and developers!
* Multi-Video Strategy: Configure up to 3 independent video bubbles.
* Smart Page Targeting: Show specific videos on specific pages (e.g., a “Sales” video on your shop and a “Support” video on your contact page).
* Human Connection: Show your face, your product, or your office to build instant credibility.
* Frictionless Sales: One click takes the user from your video directly to a WhatsApp chat with you.

Key Features

  • Triple Bubble Support: Manage up to 3 different videos simultaneously.
  • Precise Segmentation: Target videos by Page Slug or Page ID.
  • Smart Audio Control: Automatic “mute on close” and “unmute on interaction” logic for the best user experience.
  • Direct WhatsApp Integration: High-conversion CTA buttons for every bubble.
  • Premium SaaS UI: A beautiful, redesigned admin dashboard for professional management.
  • Feather-Light Performance: Highly optimized code using native HTML5. No slow jQuery.
  • API Secured Validation: State-of-the-art secure licensing system for unlimited domain access.
sections.installation:
1. Upload: Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and select the inp-video-ads-pro.zip file.
  2. Activate: Click “Activate” from the plugins page.
  3. Validate: Navigate to the “Inp-Video PRO” menu in your admin sidebar. Paste your Universal License Key to unlock all features.
  4. Configure: Set up your videos, WhatsApp numbers, and target pages. You’re live!
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely! It’s the perfect companion for WooCommerce. You can show different videos for different product categories using the targeting system.

Will it slow down my site?

Not at all. The plugin loads asynchronously and uses native HTML5 video, ensuring zero impact on your Core Web Vitals.

Can I show a video only on my homepage?

Yes! Just leave the “Target Page” field empty for your main video, or specify the slug for targeted ones.

Can I use my license on my clients’ websites?

Yes! The PRO license includes the Universal License System, allowing installation on unlimited domains.
